chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:

'Ali ibn Musa عليه السلام passed away while he was forty-nine years and some months old, in the year two hundred and two. He lived after Musa ibn Ja'far for twenty years, except for two months or three.

key_terms.عَاشَ بَعْدَ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ: he lived after Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُوسَى: Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام
key_terms.فِي عَامِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِائَتَيْنِ: in the year two hundred and two
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the age and year of the passing of Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام. It also states the length of time he lived after Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام, preserving a concise biographical detail within the hadith tradition.

en.hubeali: Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan who said,

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Musa<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was forty-nine years and one month old, in the year two hundred and two, and he<sup>asws</sup> lived after Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> for twenty years except two months or three’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibnmd al-Qasani who has said the following. “A Certain person of our people has said that he wanted to deliver an amount of propertyto al-Rida (a.s.). It was a large amount. When he saw it he did not become happy. I became depressed and said to myself, “I delivered this property to him but he did not become happy.” The Imam (a.s.) called, “O boy, bring water and the receptacle.” The narrator has said that the Imam thensat on the chair and made a hand gesture to the boy to pure water on his hand.” The narrator has said that from his hand gold began to fall in the receptacle. He then turned to me and said, “One who would be as this he does not become happy for what you would deliver to him.”
